<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Wrap the sidebar in Provider. Place the menu and groups inside Root, and put the main content in Inset. The native useSidebar hook reads the Provider context for reactive open state and toggle controls.

## Usage

```ts
import { sidebar, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/sidebar';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/sidebar`. It [registers](../../registration/) 23 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

- `components.useSidebar` · Returns the nearest Sidebar Provider’s reactive state object. Read open, openMobile, isMobile, and state from the returned object. Call toggle(), setOpen(value), or setOpenMobile(value) to change the relevant state.
